! 0-side game text
| Deploy Tatooine (with Tantive IV, non-[Reflections II] R2-D2, and Stolen Data Tapes there) and Dune Sea. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Sandwhirl or [Episode I] Jedi. While this side up, your Force drains at Tatooine system are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ Alderaan or a Tatooine battleground site. While with Devastator, Tantive IV may be forfeited to satisfy all battle damage against you. Flip this card if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered' and Rebels control two battlegrounds (a site and a system). || Deploy Tatooine (with Tantive IV, non-[Reflections II] R2-D2, and Stolen Data Tapes there) and Dune Sea. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Sandwhirl or [Episode I] Jedi. While this side up, your Force drains at Tatooine system are -1. Once per turn, may ▼ Alderaan or a Tatooine battleground site. {{Errata hl|1=Until the start of your first turn}}, Tantive IV may be forfeited to {{Errata hl|1=cancel}} all {{Errata hl|1=remaining}} battle damage. Flip this card if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered' and Rebels control two battlegrounds (a site and a system). || — || Deploy Tatooine system (with Tantive IV, non-[Reflections II] R2-D2, and Stolen Data Tapes there) and Dune Sea. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Sandwhirl{{Errata hl|1=, Strike Planning, Admiral's Orders,}} or [Episode I] Jedi. While this side up, your Force drains at Tatooine system are {{Errata hl|1=-2}}. Once per turn, may ▼ Alderaan or a Tatooine battleground site. Until the start of your first turn, Tantive IV may be forfeited to cancel all remaining battle damage. Flip this card if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered' and Rebels control two battlegrounds (a site and a system).

! 7-side game text
| While this side up, your total battle destiny is +X, where X = number of battlegrounds occupied by Rebels of ability &lt; 4. Once per turn, may deploy a Tatooine battleground site {{Errata hl|1=from Reserve Deck; reshuffle}}. Once per turn, if you just won a battle, may retrieve 1 Force. Flip this card if you do not occupy a battleground site and a battleground system (or you do not control any locations). || While this side up, your total battle destiny is +X, where X = number of battlegrounds occupied by Rebels of ability &lt; 4. Once per turn, may {{Errata hl|1=▼ Alderaan or}} a Tatooine battleground site. Once per turn, if you just won a battle, may retrieve 1 Force. Flip this card if you do not occupy a battleground site and a battleground system (or you do not control any locations). || — || — || —

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The 7-side words of the 2015 Original are as recorded before the July 2016 erratum; no copy of the 2015 slip has been found. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it ({{Mystery|question=Did the 2015 Virtual Set 3 slip print ▼ on the 7 side|nocat=yes}}). See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
